description: Reference projects and venue/trade-show experience. Filters match case-insensitively on show, city, venue, client. projects: the photo portfolio, a selection with descriptions. trackRecord: every stand built in the years named in trackRecord.coverage (currently 2025–2026 only; projects from before 2025 are not listed, earlier years coming) — show, city, venue, hall/stand, sqm, date; client null = under NDA; trackRecord.byVenue / byShow summarise stands, halls and size ranges per venue and per show. A show missing from both does not mean lack of experience there.
name: list_reference_projects
